items.title: 8.5.1 Types of Intellectual Property (as printed; patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs, trade secrets) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of printed 8.4.1 Types of Intellectual Property (PDF 202), with MCQ 9 and short questions 7-8 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Is hisse mein intellectual property ki alag alag qismein hain: patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs aur trade secrets. (Kitab ne yahan 8.5 ke neeche ghalti se number 8.4.1 chhapa hai.)

Patent kisi invention (ijad) par diya gaya khaas aur akela haq (exclusive right) hai. Invention aisa product ya process (tareeqa) hai jo koi kaam karne ka naya tareeqa de ya kisi masle ka naya technical hal pesh kare. Patent doosron ko inventor (ijad karne wala) ki ijazat ke baghair woh invention banane, istemal karne ya bechne se rokta hai.

Misal: ek Pakistani engineer naya solar panel ijad karta hai jo dhoop ko energy mein zyada behtar tareeqe se badalta hai. Patent le kar engineer pakka karta hai ke kuch tay saalon tak Pakistan mein sirf wohi yeh solar panel bana aur bech sakta hai.

Trademark aisa nishan (sign), logo ya naam hai jo ek company ke maal ya services ko doosri companies se alag pehchan deta hai. Trademarks se gahak (consumers) pehchante hain ke product ya service kis company ki hai, aur yeh brand ki pehchan (brand recognition) banane ke liye zaroori hain.
Misal: National Foods ka logo trademark hai; masalon aur sauces jaise products par dekh kar gahak foran brand pehchan lete hain.

Copyright literary aur artistic kaam ki hifazat karta hai, jaise kitabein, music, films, paintings aur software. Yeh banane wale ko apna kaam istemal karne, phailane (distribute) aur license dene (doosron ko istemal ki ijazat dene) ka akela haq deta hai, aur doosron ko bina ijazat copy ya istemal karne se rokne ka haq bhi.
Misal: ek Pakistani author (likhne wala) novel likhta hai. Copyright law pakka karta hai ke sirf usi ko novel chhapne, bechne ya us par film banane ka haq ho.

Industrial design rights cheezon ke visual design (dekhne mein shakal) ki hifazat karte hain jo sirf kaam chalau (purely utilitarian) nahi hote. Is mein product ki shakal (shape), banawat (configuration) aur khoobsurti wali baatein (aesthetic aspects) shamil hain jo use unique (sab se alag) aur dilkash banate hain.

Misal: Karachi ka ek designer mineral water ke naye brand ke liye unique aur stylish bottle ki shakal banata hai. Design ko mehfooz karne se koi aur company apne products ke liye wohi bottle ki shakal istemal nahi kar sakti.

Trade secret aisi raaz wali (confidential) maloomat hai jo karobar ko doosron par competitive edge (doosron se aage rehne ka faida) deti hai. Patents ke ulat trade secrets public (aam logon) ko nahi bataye jate. Companies inhein confidentiality agreements (raaz rakhne ke agreements) aur doosre qanooni tareeqon se bachati hain.

Misal: kitab ke mutabiq mashhoor Pakistani soft drink Pakola ki recipe trade secret hai. Company mein sirf chand log drink banane ke asal ingredients (cheezein) aur un ke proportions (kaunsi cheez kitni) jante hain.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsi intellectual property ki qisam NAHI hai? (MCQ 9)  Trademark ka maqsad bataiye. (Short question 7)  Copyright patent se kaise alag hai? (Short question 8)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 9: (d) Physical Properties; patents, trademarks aur copyrights teeno IP ki qismein hain. (Kitab ki answer key (b) Trademarks deti hai, jo text ke khilaf hai.) Short question 7: trademark (nishan, logo ya naam) ek company ke maal ya services ko doosron se alag pehchan deta hai, gahak ko batata hai ke product kis ka hai, aur brand ki pehchan banata hai. Short question 8: copyright literary aur artistic kaam (kitabein, music, films, paintings, software) ki hifazat karta hai aur copy karne se rokta hai; patent invention (naya product ya process, naya technical hal) ki hifazat karta hai aur doosron ko use banane, istemal karne ya bechne se kuch tay saalon tak rokta hai.

items: IP ki paanch qismein: Patents (inventions), Trademarks (logo, naam), Copyrights (kitabein, music, software), Industrial Designs (shakal), Trade Secrets (raaz maloomat).
Trade secrets public nahi kiye jate; patents ke ulat.
